اغلنثيا (form IIIq)
# اِغْلَنْثَيَا (iḡlanṯayā) /iɣ.lan.θa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
# اِغْلَنْثِيَا (iḡlanṯiyā) /iɣ.lan.θi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
